name: Terra Claw
description: Built for technical trail. Deep 6mm lugs deliver serious traction on wet rock and loose descents, and the ripstop upper is hard-wearing enough to survive repeated scree contact. The durable ripstop upper and robust outsole are designed to withstand frequent use on rugged terrain.
